package.name: calib_pose_tour
package.description: Moves fp3_hand through a series of poses spanning the real pick working volume (close to the camera, varied orientations) so the operator can take easy_handeye2 calibration samples at each stop -- instead of guiding the arm by hand. Talks to the /move_action server exposed by fp3_moveit_server's move_group (from franka_demo_ws, not duplicated here -- source that workspace alongside this one at runtime).
